description:
Called once per request, before the logger every Monolog channel shares is built. Listeners can add, remove or replace its handlers and processors.

Callback signature:

\XF\App $app, array &$handlers, array &$processors

Arguments:

  1. \XF\App $app - the application.
  2. array &$handlers - Monolog handlers, built from the add-on's options and config.php.
  3. array &$processors - Monolog processors, run in array order.

These are Monolog objects, not PSR-3 ones. XenForo 2.4 bundles Monolog 3 and its copy is loaded ahead of this add-on's Monolog 2, so a handler or processor written to work on both should leave its record parameters untyped.
